description: Resident repair layer for DeepSeek Harness that detects fused tool calls and splits glued JSON objects at top-level boundaries.
plugin_description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts stream errors caused by fused tool calls, splits glued top-level JSON objects, and re-throws unprovable buffers.
core_description: Pure tool-call splitting and repair engine for DeepSeek Harness. Guarantees that unproven buffers are never emitted and original failures are re-thrown unchanged.
release_blurb:
### 0.3.1

0.3.1 is the installable release of dsh-remedy. Plugin 0.3.0 carries a literal `workspace:*` dependency and cannot be installed from the registry.

Patches P-0001, P-0002 and P-0003 are all verified on a real host (P-0003's live run is the one whose journal wrote a non-zero `refused`). The counter line carries eight names while the four verdict words are unchanged.

Live evidence: [data/results/live-2026-11-09T17-00-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-09T17-00-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-desktop-2026-11-09T19-10-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-desktop-2026-11-09T19-10-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json), and [data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json).
